issues.where: ring system above the limb (crops A, C, F, G in image-06.png; crops J, O in image-07.png)
issues.what: thin ringlets wobble in crooked waves, fork into Y-branches, cross over adjacent strands, stop in mid-air above the bright limb, and show stair-stepped pixel aliasing along the brightest ring
issues.fix: render the rings from true concentric 3D elliptical geometry with clean anti-aliasing and proper occultation behind the planet and atmosphere

issues.where: ring arcs on upper left, lower left, and right side over the Milky Way (crops B, D, E, F, G in image-02.png; crops J, O, Q in image-03.png; crop T in image-04.png)
issues.what: inner ringlets wiggle, split, and break into noisy dotted scratches, the right-side ring bundle dissolves and vanishes mid-sky inside the Milky Way, the lower-left rings pinch abruptly into the limb, and the bright outer ring is stair-stepped
issues.fix: replace painted/diffused ring lines with continuous, anti-aliased 3D concentric ring geometry that maintains consistent orbital curvature and opacity across the background

issues.where: planet cloud deck across the disk and near the limb (crops A, D, H in image-06.png; crops N, O in image-07.png; crops S, T, U in image-08.png)
issues.what: the surface looks airbrushed and smeared like painted brushstrokes running diagonally into the horizon without spherical foreshortening, with a blurry speckled white smudge in crop U
issues.fix: project sharp, high-resolution zonal cloud bands and storm detail onto true spherical UVs so features foreshorten naturally toward the limb

issues.where: dark-side right and bottom limb and sunlit lower-left limb (crops C, D, E in image-02.png; crops O, P in image-03.png; crop U in image-04.png)
issues.what: the shadowed hemisphere is filled with flat noisy teal bounded by a hard, stair-stepped bright cyan rim against space, while the sunlit lower-left limb has a jagged edge and an inner doubled cyan line
issues.fix: darken the unlit hemisphere realistically, remove the bright cutout rim on the night limb, and use smooth anti-aliased atmospheric scattering along the sunlit limb

issues.where: sunlit planet limb curve (crops A, E in image-06.png; crops S, V in image-08.png)
issues.what: the horizon edge shows visible stair-stepped pixelation and a doubled bright-and-cyan inner band just inside the atmospheric glow
issues.fix: anti-alias the planetary silhouette at supersampled resolution and use a single continuous radial atmospheric falloff without a doubled inner rim

issues.where: Milky Way band and lower-left starfield (crops E, F, H in image-02.png; crop Q in image-03.png; crops S, V, W in image-04.png)
issues.what: Milky Way stars are soft fuzzy blobs and clumped smears over blotchy painterly dust, and corner stars in crop S are diagonally elongated with red-blue color fringing
issues.fix: use a crisp, high-resolution starfield and nebula plate with clean point-spread star profiles free of clumped blobs and corner chromatic smear

issues.where: upper-left and upper-right moons (crops B, C in image-02.png; crops J, L in image-03.png)
issues.what: both moons have jagged stair-stepped limbs and soft blobbed painterly surfaces, and the upper-right moon has a stray orange-brown smudge detached from its lower-right dark limb
issues.fix: render the moons as clean anti-aliased 3D spheres with sharp surface relief, consistent lighting, and no stray halo smudges on the dark limb

issues.where: dark sky between the right limb and the rings (crop E in image-06.png; crops P, Q in image-07.png; crop V in image-08.png)
issues.what: faint stray curved and diagonal ghost streaks float disconnected in empty black space
issues.fix: clean up the sky background and remove stray floating streaks outside the ring plane

issues.where: dark sky below the lower-left limb (crop D in image-02.png; top edge of crops S, T in image-04.png)
issues.what: a muddy rainbow-colored smudge patch and a tiny stray streak sit in open space
issues.fix: remove the blotchy chromatic smudge and stray streak from the lower-left starfield

issues.where: tile V, lit clouds along the bottom
issues.what: the streaks are smeared along one diagonal and look airbrushed, with no small eddies
issues.fix: break the flow into eddies and add fine cloud detail that is not stretched along the streak

issues.where: tile E, center and lower cloud deck
issues.what: the same soft directional smudge, so the deck reads painted rather than turbulent
issues.fix: add high-frequency cloud structure and vary the streak direction

issues.where: tile E, lit face of the disk
issues.what: the atmosphere is broad, smooth vertical streaks and low on storm detail
issues.fix: add storm-scale texture and ease the uniform vertical stretch

issues.where: tile E, upper right, thinnest bright ring arcs
issues.what: those thin arcs stair-step against the sky
issues.fix: widen the ring filter so the brightest strands stay smooth on a curve
